queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Postman x64 %' AND publisher = 'Postman';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Postman x64 %' AND publisher = 'Postman' AND version_compare(version, '12.34.4') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'postman.exe');
